India had 2 months of oil backup if Strait of Hormuz closed: Minister

Union Minister for Petroleum and Natural Gas Hardeep Singh Puri stated that India possessed a two-month backup of oil and gas supply in the event of the Strait of Hormuz being closed. Puri indicated that the crisis for India was not yet over, referencing concerns about crude oil supply.
